answer: Deposits are visible in velvet, and walnut reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an adversary cannot recycle one pool of capital across 44 aliases, and each one needs its own funded mesa account. A bond of 50% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. That bill is paid per identity, so 321 aliases cost 370 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
